title: He Left Work To Help A Stranger

lines.text: Kofi. Security says you left the gate yesterday. Explain.
An old man fell outside, boss. His bus money was gone.
So you lost two hours of work for a stranger?
He was alone. I paid for his taxi and walked him home.
Nobody does that. Not in this city.
Maybe that is why he cried.
He said his son never visits. He lost his number years ago.
Mister Mensah. Blue cap. He lives near the old market.
My father wears a blue cap. Mensah is my family name.
Kwame had not spoken to his father in nine years. That evening, he drove to the old market.
One small kindness can bring a whole family home.
